testEvidence.reason: read-only candidate denied dogfood fixture materializers with EPERM after relevant requirements coverage passed

verifiedBehavior: Fresh ASCII-safe clarification traverses the actual adapter and executor, returns needs_clarification, checkpoints it, and exact replay makes zero additional executor calls.

Exact clarification response continuation traverses the real runtime, returns change_set_drafted, preserves native artifacts and provenance, computes exhaustive changed sections, and exact replay makes zero additional calls.

Exact approved historical sourceRefs pass in workingRequirements and full replacement; mutation of role, artifactId, digest, schema, mediaType, uri, location, jsonPointer, or addition of fields changes whole-reference identity and fails closed.
New sourceRefs require a declared base role and its exact invocation pointer.

Forbidden authority, provider or binding substitution, hidden context, stale/no-op/baseline drift, pair mismatch, malformed output, and greenfield output from a baseline invocation remain fail closed.
residualRisks: The full repository suite could not complete in the read-only candidate worktree because unrelated dogfood tests materialize checked-in fixtures; this is an environment limitation, not a relevant assertion failure.
Historical sourceRef authorization proves exact membership in the supplied approved baseline, not continued retrievability of every historical artifact.
Durable checkpoint and artifact persistence remain host responsibilities; live OpenSpec CLI interoperability is not claimed.

integrationAuthorization.scope: Only the four digest-matched files declared by the worker handoff.
conditions: ChangeIntegration must revalidate the exact candidate digests.
No unrelated dirty-worktree changes are authorized.
